verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents full compatibility with the ClickHouse native protocol, HTTP interface, plain MergeTree DDL and unchanged SQL. It also says the s3()/url() table functions work as documented, so data and schema stay reachable through standard ClickHouse tooling, and the migration guidance (recreate schema, bridge data through object storage) implies the path works in reverse. However, the docs only describe migrating onto ObsessionDB, and the packed-storage layout means the underlying stored objects are not stock ClickHouse parts. missing for 10: a documented export/off-boarding path, explicit open-format bulk export (e.g., Parquet/CSV dumps of all data), schema export guidance, and independent corroboration of leaving the service.
